extraction.Name: John Scissons (Dec'd); questionnaire answered by Jeffrey H. Scissons (father)
extraction.NOTES: John Scissons died November 14, 1928. Questionnaire answered by his father, Jeffrey H. Scissons, age 65. Land sold for about $600. No mortgage. John was not married at the time he sold the land. He left no children. Widow named Emma Scissons. Fee patent received in 1913 from Ponca Issue Station. No application on file per father's knowledge. Subscribed and sworn June 6, 1929; notary commission expires Feb. 18, 1932.
